newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK AIRFORCE FLEW 44 SEARCH & RESCUE MISSIONS IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK AIRFORCE FLEW 44 SEARCH & RESCUE MISSIONS IN JULY.

text.p: Greek airforce aircraft, including C-130 transport planes, Dornier and helicopters, flew 141 flight hours in 44 search and rescue missions and transport of 59 patients from mainly border areas in July, the airforce general command said.

In addition, in July there were 425 fire-fighting missions with CL 215, PZL and Grumman aircraft which logged 643 flight hours, it saidin a statement. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
